title: Mirabel and the Sigil
premise: Ada Ashgrove has spent her nineteen years in Hollowmere, the last valley where the guild's null-magic still holds and the court beneath Mount Veyre cannot reach. When a dying courier named Tam presses a blood-marked map into her hands, she learns her guildmaster sold his own soul to the Undercourt decades ago to buy the valley's protection — and the debt is due. Guided by Tam's ghost and hunted by the court's sigil-bearers, Ada descends beneath the mountain to steal back what was sold, discovering along the way that the price of survival was paid with a hundred other souls, including Tam's. In the end she must choose between restoring her guildmaster and freeing the stolen souls, and she chooses justice over love, shattering the valley's protection but breaking the Undercourt's claim forever.
about_author: Casper Kavanagh is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing medieval land deeds before turning to fiction. They write fantasy about ordinary people caught in bargains they never signed.

chapters.title: The Valley That Forgets
chapters.summary: Ada's POV. We meet Hollowmere and its dwindling guild through Ada's restless eyes as she tends the boundary stones that keep magic out — and wonder in. Her guildmaster Merric is kind but evasive about the guild's past. A stranger staggers across the boundary at dusk, bleeding light instead of blood. Emotional beat: longing for a life larger than the valley.

chapters.title: A Map Written in Blood
chapters.summary: Ada's POV. The dying courier, Tam, presses a map into her hands and makes her swear to carry it to the mountain before the next new moon. He dissolves into motes of light, leaving only his voice. Merric goes pale when he sees the map and forbids her to leave. Emotional beat: grief and the first taste of obligation.

chapters.title: What Merric Signed
chapters.summary: Ada's POV, with an interlude in Merric's memory. Searching the guild archive, Ada finds the original contract: Merric sold his soul to buy the valley's null-magic shield, and the map is the ledger of every soul the Undercourt holds. She confronts him; he confesses and begs her to stay. Emotional beat: betrayal braided with love.

chapters.title: Crossing the Null Line
chapters.summary: Tam's ghost POV. Ada slips past the boundary stones at night; magic floods back into her like cold water. Tam's ghost appears — he cannot rest until the ledger is destroyed. Sigil-bearers pick up their trail within hours. Emotional beat: exhilaration curdling into fear.

chapters.title: The Ferryman's Toll
chapters.summary: Tam's POV. At the river town of Greywash, Ada bargains passage with a ferrywoman who demands a memory as payment. Ada surrenders her memory of her mother's face. The sigil-bearers burn the town's records behind them. Emotional beat: the first installment of the story's central question — what survival costs.

chapters.title: Sigil and Shadow
chapters.summary: Alternating Ada/Tam POV. Ambushed on the mountain road, Ada kills a sigil-bearer in self-defense and takes his mark, which lets her pass wards — but slowly brands her. Tam confesses he once served the Undercourt and betrayed it by stealing the ledger. Emotional beat: guilt shared becomes trust.

chapters.title: The Court Beneath the Mountain
chapters.summary: Tam's POV. They enter Veyre's under-halls, where the stolen souls are kept as living candlelight. Ada finds Merric's soul already harvested and waiting — the debt called early. The Undercourt offers her a trade: Merric's freedom for the ledger and Tam. Emotional beat: temptation sharpened by tenderness.

chapters.title: The Bargain Refused
chapters.summary: Ada's POV. Ada learns the hundred caged souls power the valley's shield itself — saving Merric means feeding everyone else forever. She refuses the trade, and the court brands her a thief of souls. Tam sacrifices his chance at rest to break the cages open. Emotional beat: love against duty, duty winning.

chapters.title: When the Candles Go Out
chapters.summary: Ada's POV, climax. Fleeing upward with a hundred souls and the burning ledger, Ada fights the Undercourt's warden across the collapsing under-halls. She burns the contract with Merric's name in its own flame, unmaking the debt — and the valley's shield dies with it. Emotional beat: triumph inseparable from loss.

chapters.title: Hollowmere, Unprotected
chapters.summary: Ada's POV, resolution. She returns to a valley where magic now flows freely and the guild's purpose is ended. Merric, mortal and freed, asks forgiveness; Ada offers it but will not stay. With Tam finally at rest and the sigil fading from her skin, she walks out of Hollowmere toward a world she can finally change. Emotional beat: bittersweet freedom.
